lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A vertical arrangement of three high-luminance circular clusters is centered in the mid-flank posterior to the pectoral fin, with a parallel secondary column of three clusters further posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the circular high-luminance blobs, forming a discernible grid-like pattern across the lateral flank.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A small, localized circular indentation or lesion with a dark center is visible on the flank, positioned immediately above a high-luminance spot and indicated by a blue graphical arrow.
other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a dense population of smaller, high-luminance pixel clusters that are significantly smaller and more numerous than the blobs on the primary lateral body.
